title: SWF: RemoveObject2 tag on layer removal
description: Unit tests verifying RemoveObject2 (tag 28) tags are emitted when display objects are removed between frames. Create a doc with a SymbolInstance on frame 0 only (not on frame 1), export SWF, verify RemoveObject2 tag (type 28) appears in the tag stream before ShowFrame for frame 2. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/removeobject.test.ts.
